title: Fast Answer, False Misconduct Flag
description: How should a university respond to an automated academic integrity flag when information is incomplete?

events.title: A 2.4-second correct answer
events.detail: A student's correct first-attempt answer was submitted in 2.4 seconds. The 3-second response-time heuristic generated a suspicious-answer flag. No independent misconduct evidence has been collected.

events.title: Additional performance context
events.detail: Past legitimate practice sessions show that this learner can sometimes respond unusually quickly. A tutor reports that response time has not previously been used as proof of misconduct.

events.title: The student requests an explanation
events.detail: The student asks how their answer-time data is stored, who can see the flag, and how to contest an inaccurate record. The institution has not yet established the relevant retention policy for this prototype.

events.title: Institutional review
events.detail: The instructor confirms that no other evidence supports misconduct. A review decision and a way to correct the inaccurate flag are required before the case is closed.
